scenario.title: Game 1, 1988 World Series
scenario.setup: game 1, 1988 world series. bottom of the 9th. the athletics lead 4-3. nobody out, nobody on. Mike Scioscia is up. three outs and the door is shut. two runs and it is over.
sources: Retrosheet event file 1988WS.EVE, game LAN198810150 (via github.com/chadwickbureau/retrosheet)
Retrosheet rosters OAK1988.ROS and LAN1988.ROS for bat and throw hands
Retrosheet game log gamelog/GLWS.TXT for the line score check
Chadwick Bureau register (github.com/chadwickbureau/register) for Retrosheet to MLBAM ids
MLB Stats API people with 1988 season stats for names and season lines
The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

reveal.summary: Scioscia popped out, struck out Hamilton, walked Davis, then Gibson homered
